## Description

Create a series (e.g. weekly physiotherapy × 10): each occurrence is a normal appointment booked through the same concurrency path; conflicts are reported before confirming; editing/cancelling one occurrence or "this and following".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Creating a series shows which occurrences conflict and lets the user skip or move them before confirming.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each occurrence is an independent appointment protected by the double-booking rules.
- [ ] **AC3.** Cancelling "this and following" cancels the remaining series with one reason and one notification.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
